title: Sincerity
paragraphs: And so, we arrived at the eastern village.
“It’s strange how smoothly we got here.”
“Yeah. Even regarding the guilds, nothing happened…”
“It’s unsettling. Maybe we should investigate what’s going on in Melromarc before moving forward.”
“Shall we stop by the village, then?”
At Éclair’s suggestion, Father and the others shook their heads.
“There’s no need to advertise our presence recklessly.”
“Indeed. We’re unrelated to them, and from what I’ve heard, they’re a bunch of greedy people. It’s best not to get involved.”
“They seem blinded by money. If things go south, it’s better to just keep quiet.”
It seemed everyone was in agreement. Well, that village was full of hopeless people. There were a few decent ones, but dealing with them would just be a hassle.
“Shall we move on, then?”
“Yeah. Motoyasu-kun, do you know where the nest is?”
“I do. But before that, it might be better to wait where the corpse was found.”
“True. The nest is likely a place it feels the need to protect. If we’re going to negotiate, it should be somewhere it feels comfortable talking.”
“By the way, Father, about Rival we’re negotiating with to join us…”
“What? Is there something else?”

“Rival, who died once, now has a new body… and that body has its own consciousness. They seem to be cohabiting in the same body. Rival said that if their current self remains alive, they won’t be able to meet you, and it’s causing them trouble.”
“Hmm… Two consciousnesses in one body? So, it’s the physical body asking for help? We’ll have to talk to them to understand, but that sounds complicated.”
“It does seem rather intricate.”
“Either way, we’ll have to meet and persuade them. With our current strength, it’s possible.”

Father and the others changed their weapons to their most enhanced forms. At this level, no one could match them. Now, we just had to do what needed to be done. Thanks to my warning, Ren wouldn’t end up killing Rival whom Assistant had asked me to protect.
“So… this is where the dragon’s corpse was found…”
That massive-looking dragon had definitely died here. Now then… what to do? This was still a monster-infested area. If we just stood here quietly, monsters would occasionally appear.
“For now, let’s wait.”
“Let’s be ready for combat at any time.”
“It’d be great if it just showed up on its own, but it seems timid… If it runs, we’re in trouble.”
“We should suppress our killing intent and presence as much as possible.”
“Easier said than done. We’re still not that experienced in battle, so it’s difficult.”
“Yeah. But if I was able to defeat it based on game knowledge, then it might actually show up pretty carelessly.”
“By estimation, being a Hero might give us some kind of bonus. Compared to people of this world, it’s probably at the level where someone at level 80 could defeat it.”
“That sounds about right. Either way… actually, we might struggle more with keeping the Filolials calm around the dragon’s presence,” Ren muttered as he watched Yuki-chan and the others.
Indeed. Yuki-chan and the others were restlessly looking around, unable to stay still.
“The compatibility between Filolials and Dragons is terrible. Let’s hope this actually attracts it.”
“For now, be careful not to kill any dragon-type monsters. They might be the target dragon’s offspring.”
“Yeah.”
We made sure not to kill the monsters that appeared, instead subduing them with status ailments.
“This is surprisingly difficult.”
“We could just storm into the nest and take it by force.”
“Sincerity is important. If we want it to listen, this method is better.”
As we were talking, a monster with dragon traits appeared alongside a loud roar.
“Looks like it’s here. Itsuki, Motoyasu, stay alert. Naofumi, make sure to protect us.”
“That’s my job, so don’t worry. The real challenge will be stopping Sakura-chan and the others from charging in.”
“Ugh…”
With Father holding their reins, Yuki-chan and the others were visibly frustrated. It was likely their instincts pushing them into battle. Even I was itching to fight. But we had to hold back.
As we continued fending off attacking monsters, dark clouds began to gather in the sky. I could sense a slight magical disturbance forming.
“Is it about to show itself?”
Just as Ren muttered that, a massive dragon appeared on the cliff above us.
“GRUUUUUUUUUAAAAAHHH!”

That was a powerful roar. But at our current strength, we weren’t intimidated by it. If we showed too much force, it might try to escape—what should we do? If I blew off its wings, it wouldn’t be able to run…
“Motoyasu-kun, I can tell you’re about to do something, but don’t.”
Father caught on and stopped me.
“We’re here to negotiate, right? So how do we do that?”
“Shouldn’t we just talk honestly? Though, I’m not really confident I can pull it off.”
“Hmm… Talking with a dragon, the king of monsters… That only happens in legends. This will be difficult for me too.”
“In times like these, it’s best to leave negotiations to Naofumi, who’s good at this sort of thing.”
“Huh!? W-Well, alright. I’ll do my best.”
With some reluctance, Father stepped forward toward the hostile dragon.
“GRUUUUUUAAAAAHHH!”
Rival unleashed a powerful stream of fire.
“Naofumi!”
How dare he raise his hand against Father! He’ll have to answer for this with his own body, won’t he?
“Itsuki! Keep the Filolials under control! Eclair and I will restrain Motoyasu!”
“Ugh! Let me go!”
The flames were heading straight for Father. Even if he could handle it, there was no way I could just stand by and watch. Damn it! Ren! Let go of me!
“Air One-Way Shield!”
Father extended his hand and activated a skill. The fire released by Rival suddenly veered off course.
“Air Strike Shield V, Second Shield V!”
Then, as soon as he had Rival in range, Father conjured shields around him, restricting his movement.
“So there was a way to use it like that…”
“Hasn’t Naofumi-san done this kind of thing pretty often?”
“Has he?”
“Ren-san, during fights, you really only focus on the enemy, don’t you? Naofumi-san actually protects you quite frequently.”
“…I see. I still have a long way to go.”
“Gruaaah!?”
Rival struggled desperately to break free, but against Father’s current strength, he couldn’t do a thing. Hahaha, as expected, the weakest dragon truly is weak, isn’t it?
“Please, just listen to me. We didn’t come here to fight you.”
“Gyaooooo!”
Rival let out an even fiercer roar, showing he had no intention of listening. Father glanced back at us, looking unsure. Was it hopeless? If needed, I could handle this.
“We are the Four Legendary Heroes… I’d like you to at least understand that much. And we’ve been waiting here because we need your help.”
Rival, still struggling against his restraints, began chanting a spell in frustration.
“I guess it really is impossible…?”
Father seemed to be deep in thought despite the situation. It didn’t look like the dragon was willing to listen at all.
“Maybe I should start with something that isn’t completely disadvantageous for him…”
Muttering to himself, Father shifted his gaze to the dragon.
“You have an adopted child, don’t you? A demi-human kid. This involves that child as well. If things keep going like this, that kid is going to suffer. Are you okay with that?”
“Gyau!?”
For a brief moment, Rival froze in place.
